# Vendored font source

`Arimo-Regular.ttf` supplies conventional digits, punctuation, and selected
symbols for Cubacadabra. Its uppercase and lowercase Latin alphabet uses
Cubacadabra's original square designs instead. Arimo is distributed under the
SIL Open Font License; its license text is kept as `OFL-Arimo.txt`.

copyright notices applicable to the combined Cubacadabra font.
